messages:
maria (secops): Quick question — we're getting requests to ship SIEM extracts to external analytics partners, but the contracts vary. Can we partition exports so retention and KMS wrapping match each contract? :thinking:
ashok: Yes. Common pattern: separate S3 buckets (or prefixes) per consumer, each with its own KMS key policy and retention lifecycle. Keeps scope small for RBAC.
jamie: For RBAC changes, do we add a cross-account role or grant an internal export-service principal and let the service enforce contracts?
maria (secops): Prefer service principal + explicit allowlist per-bucket. That way we don't create dozens of long-lived roles. Need audit trail for who requested each export.
nina: Also need to record which fields were redacted before export. External contracts often forbid PII; keep a hash-only copy for forensic linkage.
ashok: Agreed. Proposed flow:
```
1) Request -> ticket with justification + TTL (owner)
2) Export service validates contract and chosen transform (redact/hash)
3) Exported objects written to consumer bucket encrypted with consumer KMS key
4) Object ACLs = internal-only, presigned URLs for delivery, logs emitted to audit index
```
jamie: What about JIT analyst access for internal teams — we still need ad-hoc queries against full logs for incident triage. Can we avoid exporting full S3 copies and instead provide a timeboxed proxy view?
maria (secops): Yes — prefer ephemeral viewer behind ID-verified justification. Log the justification, duration, and approver. TTL enforced by token service. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: FYI this will add load to the query cluster if analysts run lots of heavy exports. We should rate-limit or snapshot to a cached read-replica.
ashok: Regarding KMS, two options: per-consumer CMK with key policy restricting decrypt to export-service and that consumer's audit principal; or use a wrapping key pattern: export key wrapped by per-consumer envelope key. The latter reduces CMK sprawl.
nina: Key rotation concern — ensure exported artifacts remain decryptable for retention window. Add key-rewrap step on rotation. Also record key-id in export audit record.
maria (secops): Draft retention snippet — feedback?
```
export_retention:
  consumer_tier_A: 90d
  consumer_tier_B: 30d
  internal_forensics: 365d
  pii_scrubbed_archive: 365d
```
jamie: LGTM but add an exception path for legal holds that can extend TTL via an override flow (audit-only change).
sec-bot: Ticket #SEC-4821 created: "Segmented SIEM exports + contract-aware KMS" — assignees: maria, ashok.
sre-oncall: We'll run a bench on a 1TB snapshot to check export time and read-replica impact. ETA 48h.
maria (secops): Action items: 1) ashok to prototype envelope wrapping + policy doc (due EOD Thu), 2) jamie to draft RBAC + JIT proxy design, 3) nina to add key rotation/runbook notes, 4) sre to run perf test. I'll add runbook changes after we validate. :thumbsup:
jamie: One more — add audit index fields: export_id, requester, contract_id, key_id, transform_applied, justification. Makes post-incident review easier.
maria (secops): Good call. I'll include that in the ticket checklist and mark this thread resolved once PRs land. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
